legal_guards: Blank FSSR/FCS string in R29 is not evidence a product has no applicable law or no numeric contaminant limit.
2025 FoSCoS 102.1 is an official Category A route for named listed Ayurveda recipes. Actual manufacturer/SKU FoSCoS category must be verified separately.
The 2017/updated FSSR 2.1.17 is Cheese and Cheese Products. Ayurveda cooked dumpling recipe 14.5 may contain a cheese component, but the code is NOT independently validated as its finished standard.
FPC 18 2021 directive and Annexure II additive categories do not become standardized finished product FSSR clause by mapping names.
FPC 18 eligibility excludes products already standardized/mapped under FPC 01–14. Actual food/product classification and 2021 direction currentness require verification.
Interim edible seed class, mouth freshener classes, FPC 99 ingredients and formulated supplements require actual ingredient/finished identity and effective legal-source review.
All full-product CTR applicability holds and earlier audit source statuses retained: new legal product decisions zero.
